subject: The tree on the hill
body:
I've been reading up on the King. He lives all alone at a huge royal tree and he is not very nice.

In the middle of a fight he'll shout out Decrees, like KNEEL or DO NOT FLEE or COME NO CLOSER. Whatever he says, do it fast. He warns you once, but if you break one again your hearts get cut in half for 15 seconds. Obey him and he leaves himself open. I put where to find him in your Archive.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
